guidance.statement: FY26 mobile phone volumes expected at 40-42 million units
guidance.quote: this year numbers are going to be similar, 40 million, 42 million

guidance.statement: FY27 mobile volumes targeted at 55-60 million units; separately maintained 60-65 million target
guidance.quote: next year, we feel that we should be somewhere between 55 to 60 million

guidance.statement: IT Hardware revenue target of Rs 1,200-1,300 crores for FY26
guidance.quote: targeting revenues of almost INR 1,200 crores to Rs. 1,300 crores this year

guidance.statement: IT Hardware business to reach Rs 4,000-5,000 crores over next two years through backward integration
guidance.quote: IT business for us in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores

guidance.statement: Camera module revenues to grow to Rs 6,000-7,000 crores from 190-200 million units in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: 190 to 200 million units with revenue closer to INR 6,000 to INR 7,000 crores

guidance.statement: Display JV (HKC) business targeting $800-900 million within 2-3 years at peak smartphone volumes
guidance.quote: $800 million to $900 million of business in next two to three years

guidance.statement: Company targeting Rs 1 lakh crore (Rs 100,000 crore) total revenue in 3-4 years
guidance.quote: targeting around 1 lakh crore of sales in next three to four years

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins at Rs 1 lakh crore revenue level targeted at 4-4.5% through backward integration
guidance.quote: range can be somewhere around 4%, 4.5% as we reach 1 lakh crore

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenues INR 14,858 crores, up 29% YoY from INR 11,528 crores
Consolidated EBITDA INR 564 crores, up 34% YoY from INR 420 crores
Consolidated PAT INR 323 crores, up 27% YoY from INR 236 crores
Mobile revenue INR 13,361 crores, up 41% YoY with operating profit INR 472 crores, up 53%
Telecom revenue INR 1,635 crores, up 148% from INR 661 crores; year expected to close at Rs 4,800 crores
IT hardware revenue INR 331 crores, up 481% from INR 57 crores YoY
Acquired 51% stake in Q Tech India, consolidated financials from September 26, 2025

themes: GST rate cut in August caused customer purchase postponement, impacting Q2 volumes
Backward integration: display modules, camera modules, lithium batteries for margin accretion
Segment diversification: telecom becoming second-largest growth driver after mobile
Export expansion through Transsion/Ismartu partnership for Africa, Latin America, U.S.
New customer wins: Vivo partnership, new ODM customer, Longcheer JV approval received
Complex product expansion: microwave radios, notebook manufacturing, lighting partnerships
risks: PLI scheme expiration on March 31, 2026 may pressure mobile margins in FY27 before backward integration benefits materialize
Execution risk on complex new products: microwave radios, display manufacturing, camera modules require significant capex and expertise
Domestic smartphone market saturation: at 55-60 million units, Dixon will control 55-60% of outsourced smartphone market, limiting further volume growth
Large revenue base constrains growth rates; company acknowledged cannot sustain 100% YoY growth, moderating to 30-40% range
analyst_pushback: Analyst pressed for ODM customer granularity; management cited confidentiality but disclosed 0.5 million units/month, India-focused, incremental volume
Analyst questioned if 55-60 million unit guidance was conservative vs. prior 60-65 million target; management reiterated 60-65 as maintained guidance
Analyst noted Longcheer JV profit dilution from 100% to 74:26; management highlighted operational efficiency gains and incremental volume potential
Analyst questioned $150 billion initial market size for telecom microwave radios; management clarified new 'network equipment' category expansion beyond CPE
tone_evidence: Confident on 1 lakh crore revenue target and backward integration margin expansion, but cautious on near-term headwinds (GST impact, PLI uncertainty, execution risks, large-base growth moderation from 100% to 30-40%)
